title: Cast iron is a great item to cook in
text:
Cast iron is a great item to cook in. I'm not sure how to leave feedback for a well known traditional item, such as this.

Cast iron is a great item to cook in. Care of this is a little more work than other cookware but worth it!

I love that the lid also functions as a pan. This way you get two pieces of cookware for one price. I also love the fact that it is preseasoned. Makes it easier to get right to cooking

product_metadata.title: Westinghouse Pre-Seasoned Cast Iron 3 Quart Dutch Oven with Skillet Lid
features: Two products in one – Three quart Dutch Oven, perfect for lamb, chicken, pork or even risotto and Tight fitting lid doubles as 10 1/4 inch skillet for sautéing on the stovetop or baking in the oven
Super versatility - use on a stove top, oven, broiler or even over a campfire
Pre-seasoned and ready to use. Basic maintenance required, including drying after each cleaning. Refer to user manual for details
Easy to grip, integrated handles on both the base and lid
Thick walled construction provides excellent heat retention to keep foods warm
description: Dutch oven with tight-fitting skillet lid is perfect for a variety of cooking needs. 3-qt dutch oven makes lamb, chicken, pork or even risotto to perfection. The removable lid doubles as a skillet for sautéing on the stovetop or baking in the oven. Pre-seasoned for easy cooking and cleaning needs. Simply wash, dry and rub with cooking oil. Durable cast iron retains heat and provides an even cooking surface throughout. Easy grip handles. Measures 16.6” x 10.6” x 4.6” overall. Weighs 11.5 lbs.
